scope.mechanism: Approved generic identity, cognition, save/rebind, event, action-resource, subjective-fork and scheduling contracts, through real production assemblies and approved public ports.
scope.formal_chapter: Existing first two chapters, approximately 3–5 game days; formal story-declared virtual detective takes the player position and receives only normal visible candidates and feedback.
scope.blind_play: NOT_EXECUTED; formal automation remains DETECTION_ONLY and cannot establish play quality or real play duration
scope.level_I: NOT_EXECUTED; mechanism/chapter stress does not replace the three transcript and literary comparisons

independence.executor: A different fresh-context agent after implementation freeze; the planner is not the acceptance executor.
forbidden_inputs: chapter story source or compiled narrative contents
independence.controller_input: Explicitly reviewed player-visible projection of formal output; current opaque candidate token, visible label/text/cards and visible feedback only.
independence.controller_output: SelectCandidate with one currently issued opaque token; null only where the approved port permits no input.
independence.observer_separation: Trusted recorder may retain full authority evidence needed for semantic assertions; it is a separate port, process/channel and directory never passed to the controller.
independence.not_hard_isolation: No OS ACL or signed approval identity is provided. Record allowed-path monitoring and attempted forbidden reads; fail closed on a detected deviation. Do not claim filesystem or network isolation.
independence.violation_disposition: Stop and retain raw evidence. A contaminated chapter/controller context cannot resume as the same independent run; appoint a fresh context. Do not repair the record silently.

read_basis.disclosure: Filename enumeration was used to locate the permitted artifacts; no enumerated historical, oracle, S18 or R03 file contents were opened. F01 and diagnoses are static/prior neutral evidence, not approval or new test results.

freeze_and_gates.require: Parent supplies immutable version/commit and SHA-256 manifest for approved production binaries, public contracts, compiler, capability catalog, loader/codec and formal chapter input package. Executor records its own binary hashes and environment before running.
freeze_and_gates.failure: BLOCKED_FROZEN_INPUT; no old PASS or old assembly substitution

freeze_and_gates.require: Real approved IR/compiler → loader → subject interpretation/snapshot → decision → action submission ports exist for both generated neutral topologies. Use production assembly references; reject copied implementation, DTO-only V00 fixture and custom fallback executor.
freeze_and_gates.failure: BLOCKED_PRODUCTION_PORT, separately report any executable narrower Core stress

freeze_and_gates.require: Public revision-consistent capture/evaluate, explicit atomic observation batch, immutable audit, persistent identity/rebind and subjective fork contracts are published. Unknown version, capability, AST/property and reference have typed rejections before publication.
freeze_and_gates.failure: BLOCKED_CAPABILITY for the corresponding suite; do not use internal ApplyBatch or reflection to manufacture coverage

freeze_and_gates.require: Formal continuous save/load port documents exact save cuts and pending-action/lease/presentation behavior. Unsupported active states explicitly reject, without clearing state. Full active continuation coverage requires an actually supported restore path.
freeze_and_gates.failure: A correct active-state rejection can PASS the rejection assertion only; ACTIVE_CONTINUATION remains NOT_SUPPORTED_NOT_COVERED

freeze_and_gates.require: Formal story-declared detective and real player-candidate port, production candidate refresh, action start/finish, presentation completion, perception and clock handling are connected. Each wire field is approved as currently player-visible.
freeze_and_gates.failure: BLOCKED_FORMAL_CHAPTER; no menu-id reinterpretation, chapter probe, debug jump, answer injection or neutral loop substitute

freeze_and_gates.require: Environment has .NET 8, Python 3 and correct Godot .NET runtime where needed. Record executable paths/versions, build configuration, physical RAM/free RAM, CPU/OS, storage/free disk and background load. Available disk must meet estimated unfiltered log volume plus 2 GiB margin.
freeze_and_gates.failure: BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT; do not reduce fixed matrix to silently obtain PASS

determinism.seed_derivation: SHA-256 of UTF-8 AR-CORE-01/STRESS/v1/{index padded to four digits}; first eight digest bytes interpreted unsigned big-endian. Save the full digest and 64-bit seed for every index.
determinism.rng: Harness-only SplitMix64 with explicitly frozen version and unsigned 64-bit wrapping; never depend on system Random or wall time for scenario choices.
determinism.substreams: SHA-256 of full base digest + UTF-8 /{topology}/{suite}/{phase}; distinct generation/controller/fault/schedule streams. Repetition keeps identical inputs and controlled commit schedule.
determinism.concurrency: One cell process at a time for acceptance timing; four actual reader tasks with one writer. Record barrier order, actual commit order, thread identifiers and observed revisions. Deterministic seeds do not imply deterministic OS interleavings.
determinism.repeat_comparison: Compare semantic outputs/revisions, conservation and stop reasons with exact controlled commit order. Normalize only process-specific opaque session handles and timestamps with a recorded bijection; never normalize entity/facet/subject identity, failures or causal order.
determinism.counterexample: Save original seed, full generated fixture/IR, raw trace and actual interleaving before shrinking. Shrinker deletes neutral operations/unused entities only, runs a new labeled reproduction, and must preserve the same semantic failure; never replaces the original evidence.

matrix.neutral_names: Generated opaque instance labels with NFC/NFD and duplicate-display-name samples; no chapter names, terms, answers or author global dictionary in a subject.

topologies.shape: Bidirectional ring of 8/16/32 spaces with additional 4 station leaves, direct support objects and multiple facets on selected shared identities.
properties: connectivity
symmetric declared travel edges
flat containers
shared limited resource

topologies.shape: Directed branching graph of 9/17/33 spaces, declared one-way entries and a separate return branch; containers nested to depth 2/4/8 and asymmetric facet visibility.
properties: no implicit reverse edge
nested containment
locked ancestor
independent non-equivalent subject dictionaries

matrix.construction: Generate neutral author declarations/IR through approved formal compiler and loader. Trusted fixture construction controls neutral initial conditions; assertions observe public production behavior. It cannot substitute for formal chapter/player input.
matrix.unit_accounting: Count setup declarations separately. Each suite records requested, accepted, rejected, committed, cancelled, resumed, timed-out and missing operations. A suite cannot PASS when target counts or required branch coverage were not reached.

mechanism_suites.name: entity/facet churn and subjective identity
mechanism_suites.mix: 500 entity add/remove requests, 500 facet add/remove requests, 500 rename/forget/re-recognize requests, 500 interpretation or invalid-handle requests. Require both successful add/remove and each rejection class; cap live entities at the tier count by pairing removals/additions.
properties: Persistent IDs are NFC/Ordinal and never silently trimmed, reused after delete or rebound by display name; stale/cross-world/cross-subject handles reject before mutation.

Same entity may have distinct facets; same visible word may remain ambiguous; Unknown qualifier cannot be discarded as False. Unrecognized/Ambiguous/Unknown/Unsupported/InvalidReference/Stale/Resolved remain distinct.

Rename preserves identity; delete and create with the same visible name produces a different identity. Subject re-recognition uses new valid membership without recovering forgotten facts from authority history.
A legally submitted physical action keeps its original approved binding when target cognition is forgotten; objective deletion may fail at commit. No implicit cancellation due to Forget.
Declared one-way or locked access stays enforced by actual commit, independent of a subject's belief. Labels never confer capabilities.
mechanism_suites.coverage_note: Facet removal and persistent-ID APIs must exist at the approved public loader/runtime boundary. If absent, record exact blocked operations; do not remove internal fields directly.

mechanism_suites.name: multi-reader cognition batches and failure atomicity
mechanism_suites.invalid_mix: 16 foreign-subject references, 16 stale references, 16 containment cycles, 16 unknown required capability/AST or malformed graph requests; vary invalid element first/middle/last. Complete validation precedes publication.
properties: Each successful nonempty explicit batch advances exactly one cognition revision. Empty/invalid batches leave revision, complete graph and emitted committed-change count unchanged.

A captured immutable graph includes names/kinds/existence/parents/tags/positive and denied relations/accepted weighted rules/procedures/visible sources from one revision. Old snapshots cannot change after new commits.

Generate two complete states whose long conjunction is False in both, but whose mixed leaves would yield True. Concurrent writers/readers must never report the impossible True or a mixed metadata tuple.

Every AST evaluation, interpretation, scoring or plan reports one revision; multiple separate calls may observe newer revisions. Subject isolation holds under simultaneous commits to different subjects.

Post-commit public notifications and a reader reentering capture see only a complete old or complete new graph; no half batch and no deadlock. No public notification means this subcase is BLOCKED, not inferred from History.
mechanism_suites.schedule: Run controlled commit barriers and unconstrained reader overlap separately within the 256 batches; freeze the generated operations and log actual overlap. Do not instrument individual production AST leaves or copy its evaluator.

mechanism_suites.name: Forget, immutable history and cross-process save/rebind
properties: Capture old complete audit and subjective snapshots; rename/change/Forget later. Old byte/hash and value fields remain unchanged; audit retains immutable changes and tombstone while a current subject snapshot does not regain forgotten content.

Restore allocates and validates the full object graph then rebinds in a second phase; all persistent identity domains, cross-reference targets, body-control mappings, rules and AST procedures remain semantically equivalent without source object aliases.

At supported formal save cuts, restore reality, cognition, time/units, chapter/flow position, random state, candidate generation and supported pending state. Repeated loads of the same snapshot reproduce the same subsequent public behavior under the same visible selections.
Invalid version/capability/property/AST, missing references and truncated/corrupt input explicitly reject before publishing a new session; the live session and its pending work remain unchanged.

For active action, conditional wait, temporary lease and pending presentation, test 2 probes each. If continuation is unsupported, assert a typed rejection and no state clearing or initial-state rerun. Record active continuation as NOT_SUPPORTED_NOT_COVERED; a rejection PASS does not satisfy full persistence.

After a fresh-process successful restore, mutations in restored and retained source sessions are isolated. Cross-process rebind must not depend on original reference equality, display names, callbacks or arbitrary reflection types.
mechanism_suites.continuation_comparison: Compare one uninterrupted neutral branch and one save/restore branch using the same seed and formal public operations, but only at supported cuts. Divergence is a counterexample. No expected chapter answer is supplied.

mechanism_suites.name: event receipt and repeated-load idempotency
properties: Record original event ID/type/time-unit/phase/result/source/causes and authorized recipient projection. Three duplicate receipts per event cover immediate repeat, after acknowledgment and after a post-acknowledgment checkpoint restore.

Each presentation completion or committed action effect is applied at most once per event in a single session lineage. Duplicate/unknown/out-of-order/stale-epoch receipt explicitly rejects or is an acknowledged no-op; it must not spend again, resume twice or regenerate initial observations.

Restoring a pre-event checkpoint is a separate branch, not proof of global exactly-once across all histories. Compare documented event lineage/epoch semantics and never suppress legitimate post-checkpoint work.

A consumed/refreshed/foreign/unknown candidate token cannot be accepted again or mapped by visible label. Loading an old snapshot cannot make a current session's stale token valid unless the published restore contract explicitly issues a new token.
Speech/observation/propagation/presentation/action remain different event kinds; claimed openness or an accepted request alone cannot change authority access or establish actual arrival.
mechanism_suites.negative_boundary: Malformed duplicate JSON keys, unknown fields/types, over-limit messages and wrong actor/session are exercised through the real port and preserved unfiltered. Unreviewed output types fail closed.

mechanism_suites.name: resource conservation, contention and cancellation release
mechanism_suites.round_mix: 128 cancellation-before-commit, 64 cancellation-during-lifecycle-lease, 64 forced-failure-in-a-later-stage. Each round has declared integer resource Q in 1..8, unit spend, a station/holder and generated finite action requirements. Record seed-derived order and actual order.
properties: For each committed stage: final quantity = initial + authorized replenishments - committed spends, never negative; total successful unit spends cannot exceed available quantity. Sixteen attempts cannot double-spend a one-unit pool.
One body has at most one pending execution. Same-instant contention, retries and duplicate receipts must not duplicate admission or resource acquisition.

Failed preparation publishes no partial effects in that stage. A committed earlier stage stays committed after later-stage failure/cancel; no assumption of whole-sequence or whole-team atomic rollback.

Lease is held only after actual acquisition and released on supported completion/cancel/failure/Dispose. Cancel the acquired execution twice; second cleanup changes nothing and cannot release another owner's newer lease.
Underlying base state changes made under a temporary overlay reappear correctly after release/expiry; overlapping independent overlays do not delete each other's layer.

Acceptance, historical completion and qualification cannot substitute for current occupancy or a shared-effect commit. For a declared instantaneous all-present Require, non-overlap must fail and overlap permits at most one actual shared commit; no new continuous-hold or group transaction primitive is assumed.

mechanism_suites.name: subjective fork, hidden-truth noninterference and budget
mechanism_suites.generation: Construct authority worlds A/B differing only in unobserved neutral tags/positions/bindings. Give each subject identical immutable visible graph, models, explicit hypotheses and RNG state. The model must be generated from approved neutral declarative data, never selected from hidden authority values.
properties: With equivalent subject snapshots/models/seeds, subjective conclusions, candidates, budgets consumed and stop reasons are equivalent across hidden-truth A/B. Observer compares authority separately; it cannot feed truth back into model or controller.

Zero step budget executes no transition/action, does not advance random state through a simulated step, emits no external UI/audio/observation and returns an explicit budget/depth/no-action distinction as appropriate.
Consumed steps/depth never exceed requested limits; exhaustion is not labeled completed/support. Unsupported/unknown/failure are not conflated with a counterexample or False.

Source reality/cognition/revision/audit/clock/leases/presentation queue are unchanged by every fork, including faults and budget stops. Later source mutations do not mutate a retained branch and branch mutations do not change source.
Authority audit uses a different entry/result/log kind. Subjective call rejects an authority input or unsupported model rather than silently falling back.

Repeat at equal known-item set while changing cognition value/source, accepted rule/weight, subject, dictionary/model/capability revision one at a time. A cache cannot return a result tagged with the previous version; unchanged inputs can reuse only an equivalent properly tagged result.
mechanism_suites.model_infection_control: A deliberately authority-derived model is a negative port/provenance sample, never the production model. Reject where the approved provenance contract requires rejection; if the API cannot establish provenance, report this exact gap instead of claiming whole-chain noninterference.

mechanism_suites.name: 16-subject clocks, deadlines and bounded retention
mechanism_suites.clock_cases: Finite integer/rational base ticks mapped through the published production CTB/game-time/presentation units; test coincident due times, positive/zero delays, cancelled/rescheduled work, blocked waits and presentation stalls. Do not give controller AdvanceWorld, VerifiedPerception or arbitrary time-unit conversion authority.
properties: CTB.Now is monotone, scheduled dispatch is not early, same-time order follows published ordering, cancelled items never activate and rescheduled items activate at most once.

Sixteen subjects exercise active, sleeping, condition-waiting and busy states. A relevant committed observation wakes a supported waiting subject once; no lost wakeup, unbounded zero-time wake loop or busy-body duplicate action.

Neutral deadlines are declared before scheduling. A job that remains feasible and admitted must finish by its declared logical deadline; impossible/blocked/cancelled jobs yield an explicit outcome rather than fabricated completion.
Use a fixed external wall-clock deadline in addition to logical time. A whole tick/phase can stop at a documented budget, retaining pending work; a budget stop is not terminal completion.

After cancel/Deactivate/Dispose, pending public queues, active leases and owned listeners must be released according to the supported API. Observe external memory trend across equal-sized live states and disposal checkpoints without introspecting internal arrays.

Audit/event retention is allowed to grow with retained evidence; measure it separately from live graph, candidate cache, pending work, search nodes and wire buffers. Disk append logs cannot be silently discarded to obtain a memory plateau.
mechanism_suites.cross_clock_gate: Core CTB alone does not prove chapter/game/presentation clock mapping. If the approved neutral host clock adapter is absent, CTB assertions may run separately but CROSS_CLOCK remains BLOCKED; formal chapter evidence must exercise the actual host clock mapping.
mechanism_suites.oversize_disposition: Explicit bounded-stop/limit rejection with full evidence. Do not truncate candidate sets to choose an answer or call a limit-truncated run PASS. Production may choose other approved advertised caps; bind and freeze them before execution and disclose any target incompatibility.

formal_chapter_stress.prerequisite: G00/G03/G04 and formal publicly visible game-day/phase progress are supported
formal_chapter_stress.base_seeds: Use all 1000 base indices; independent controller substream, never the neutral world generator substream
runs_per_seed: same visible policy and seed with supported-cut save/restore and duplicate-receipt fault schedule
formal_chapter_stress.initial_state: Start each run from the real formal title/new-session path. Declare the virtual detective in approved formal story data through the trusted host, taking the player position. No chapter probe, debug transition, replayed transcript, custom chapter simulator or preselected solution.
formal_chapter_stress.policy: Freeze a generic visible-feedback policy before chapter execution; select only current candidate tokens using visible labels, already received evidence and seed. Policy may learn from its own current run feedback. No chapter-specific labels, source IDs, numeric answers, fixed operation lists or hidden authority channel.
formal_chapter_stress.trusted_host_duties: Normal candidate request/refresh, real movement/action completion, publicly verified perception, presentation completion and production time advancement. Host transports legal choices; controller cannot synthesize these authoritative inputs.
formal_chapter_stress.horizon_measurement: Use the official public game-day/phase signal and unit mapping; if unavailable, mark HORIZON_UNOBSERVABLE. Do not infer game days from loop iterations or wall time.
formal_chapter_stress.coverage_rule: Exercise only events/checkpoints actually reached through normal input. Insufficient receipts/save cuts or a terminal state before the target horizon are recorded with reached game-day, terminal/failure/no-progress reason and missing coverage. Never invent extra days, reopen a terminal session, restart a failed controller or inject state to fill counts.
semantics: Every submitted token was in the latest visible candidates for that controller actor/session; consumed/stale/foreign tokens do not spend or progress twice.

Repeated receipt/save/load does not duplicate committed resources/events or rerun chapter initial observations. Supported continuation preserves random/time/flow/candidate semantics; unsupported active save explicitly rejects and preserves the current session.
No runaway queue, search, wakeup or negative resources across actual 3–5 day formal progression; chapter transitions retain documented identity/cognition continuity.

A hidden-truth checkpoint pair is created only by the trusted observer through an approved non-production test hook, keeping visible subject inputs identical. If no such hook is approved, this formal subcase is BLOCKED, while M06 remains the neutral noninterference evidence.

A legal policy that cannot reach the horizon is a reported policy/interface/session outcome, not automatically proof of engine semantic failure and not a successful full stress run. Retain the actual visible trace for attribution.
formal_chapter_stress.claims: Formal automated stress only; no claim of correct solution, enjoyable story, UI acceptance, independent blind play, real play duration or future 40-day capacity.

baseline_regressions.knowledge_source: Parent instruction and AR-CORE-01, not expectation contents
baseline_regressions.before_stress: Independent executor collects all current formal regression failures with unchanged existing expectations, original stdout/stderr, step/ID, binary hashes and exception evidence. Obtain a parent-supplied neutral ID index for all 27; do not read golden/oracle to reproduce answers.
baseline_regressions.entry: python tools/verify.py --keep-going; existing selected-step --only/--skip may isolate reruns after full baseline collection
baseline_regressions.entry_caveat: verify.py currently has core/scope/host/flow/flow2/gallery and injected-state checks. Its entry alone is not proof of an enumerated 27-case list; collect exact case IDs from official runner output. Missing IDs are unresolved coverage.
baseline_regressions.after_stress: Rerun the same failing case IDs against the identical frozen input version and unchanged expectations; report fixed/still failing/new/did not run independently of mechanism stress.
no_update: no mapping old PASS into the new run
baseline_regressions.dependency_rule: Build failure stops tests using that assembly; preserve the failure first. Independent unaffected suites may continue with explicit version/gate labels. Known failures do not disappear from overall status because stress passes.

measurement.performance_status: Proposed detection thresholds for this plan, not approved gameplay SLA or current measured performance. Freeze thresholds before running; do not relax after a failure.
measurement.warmup: Three separately logged small neutral cell warmups; excluded from percentiles and required counts. Formal first-load and first-decision latency remain reported, never hidden by warmup.

latency.clock: monotonic high-resolution wall clock measured by the external recorder
latency.segmentation: Separate tier/topology/suite/success/reject/cold/warm; retain every raw sample. Never average small and large tiers to hide regressions. Meaningful threshold failure is PERFORMANCE_FAIL even if semantics pass.

fields: managed heap/allocated bytes/GC counts if public runtime telemetry available
memory.checkpoints: Before load, each suite, every 256 scheduler requests, after quiescence/Dispose, and five repeated equal-live-size churn cycles. Supplement with runtime metrics only if available; record missing fields.
memory.machine_capacity: Preflight requires one worker budget plus recorder and at least 2 GiB free RAM; otherwise BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT.
memory.retention_threshold: At equal live graph/queue/lease/search sizes, post-quiescence retained memory in each of the last three churn checkpoints must not rise more than max(32 MiB, 10% of first equal-size checkpoint); report full slope and audit-byte growth separately. This is a detection criterion, not a proof of zero leaks.
memory.gc_handling: Report natural workload samples. An optional explicit-GC diagnostic is a separately labeled post-run measurement and cannot replace latency or natural memory data.

measurement.environment_sampling: Full preflight record and monotonic/UTC start/end for every process; CPU usage, available RAM and free disk every 5 seconds. Record recorder overhead and total raw log bytes. CPU/background-load changes make timing comparability qualified, not semantically normalized.
measurement.before_after_comparison: Compare a separately retained baseline run only when machine/runtime/build/input scale/seed/schedule are equivalent. No baseline timing is assumed from the old neutral diagnoses.

hard_abort: first semantic invariant violation in that cell
illegal controller authority or forbidden-read detection
execution_limits.failfast: Stop the failing cell/session immediately and seal complete raw evidence, then allow one same-seed reproduction plus a separately labeled shrink attempt. Cap each failing property at three archived reproductions. Continue other independent cells only within the frozen matrix and overall budgets to measure failure breadth.
execution_limits.partial_run: When aggregate deadline or capacity ends a shard, mark RUN_INCOMPLETE and list every unrun seed/topology/repetition/suite. Resume only into a new immutable run directory with unchanged inputs; no PASS until the exact complete matrix and formal targets are accounted for.
execution_limits.interaction: Executor emits true progress at least every 60 seconds; tool waits are bounded to 60 seconds. No process restart can extend an individual failed controller/session's budget.

per_operation: base/substream seeds and RNG state before input
requested public operation and exact request bytes
raw_evidence.channels: Separate original authority observer, player-visible wire, controller input/output, accepted normal player actions, rejected actions, event receipts and save/load raw bytes. Controller has access only to its minimal dependencies and current wire channel, enforced by DETECTION_ONLY monitoring disclosure.
raw_evidence.format: Raw stdout/stderr and wire frames saved as bytes or length-prefixed binary; JSONL has byte lengths/base64 where necessary. No decode/re-encode of original logs, newline normalization, filtering or truncation. Summaries are derived artifacts.
raw_evidence.integrity: SHA-256 and byte count for every original file, manifest with parent/child causal IDs and process sequence; verify hashes after archival and delivery. Use a local .gitattributes with -text for original evidence and -diff for binary/control-character runtime logs when the parent seals evidence.
raw_evidence.fault_tail: On timeout, retain prefix, final stdout/stderr drain, watchdog actions and termination status; do not treat drain as another accepted input. Capture incompleteness is itself EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE.
raw_evidence.old_results: Keep prior failed build/run logs and attempts in separate immutable directories. No copy of an old PASS into a new current summary.
raw_evidence.log_capacity: Estimate from warmup bytes/op multiplied by fixed planned operations plus save graph bytes; stream logs to disk with at most 4096 recent events in recorder memory. Capacity failure stops explicitly, never drops evidence.

verdict.suite_pass: Required public production path used, target counts and rejection/success coverage achieved, no semantic counterexample, thresholds/deadlines met, and raw evidence complete.
verdict.mechanism_complete: All 4000 cell runs and all enabled required semantic suites accounted for; base-seed-level no-deadlock result includes actual completed counts, not just loops scheduled. Any missing approved mechanism is BLOCKED or incomplete.
verdict.formal_complete: All 2000 formal sessions accounted for; separately report reached target horizons and required save/receipt/clock coverage. A detected policy/interface limitation is not a fake successful session.
verdict.overall: No overall remediation PASS while any required production gate, known regression, semantic failure, active continuation requirement or evidence gap remains unresolved. This plan itself makes no test PASS claim.
